prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the test tube from dispensing device to test tube rack 2.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: test tube rack 2
What the inspection checks: Check on test tube rack 2 whether there is a uncapped test tube containing transparent liquid with a small amount of colored fluid at the top.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A grey metal workbench holds a dark grey rack rail running from top-centre toward the bottom of the frame, mounted on a white aluminium extrusion beam. The rack has five circular holes; the four upper positions are empty. The nearest position holds an upright cylindrical specimen container with a bright orange screw cap, capped and closed. It carries a white label with red printing, and a red-tinted liquid is visible through the lower part of the body. At upper left is a white instrument with a green display panel showing orange digits, and a thick white plastic block sits on the bench at left. A black cable runs diagonally down the right side toward a black-and-white fitting; a blue device is at the top right corner.
observations: The test tube on rack 2 has a bright orange screw cap and is closed, contradicting the requirement for an uncapped tube.
